lessons.title: Teacher's Book
lessons.intro: Each surah is one card. Fill in the questions of each section; teachers will see them as cards at /guru.
lessons.empty: No surahs yet. Add the first surah to start entering questions.

lesson.deleteBody: {{title}} and its {{count}} sections will be deleted. The super admin can restore them from the recycle bin for 30 days.
lesson.name: Surah name
lesson.pickHint: Search by surah name or number

sectionPage.new: This section is still empty. Add questions below and save.
sectionPage.deleteBody: This section and all its questions will be deleted. The super admin can restore it from the recycle bin for 30 days.
sectionPage.noReading: No reading. Add the du'a, hadith or text teachers read before answering.
sectionPage.livePreview: Live preview · as teachers see it
sectionPage.previewNote: This is how teachers will see this section. Unsaved changes are shown too.

question.matchHint: For each row on the left, pick its correct match on the right. Teachers see the right-hand options shuffled.
question.explanationHint: Shown to the teacher after answering.

cards.empty: No questions in this section yet.
cards.wrong: Not quite. The correct answer is marked green.

access.title: Admin access
access.intro: Invite the admins who run the learning platform. They sign in with Google using the email you invite.
access.isSuper: That is the super admin's account.
access.already: {{email}} is already a learning platform admin.
access.failed: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.
access.invited: {{email}} can now open the learning platform. Send them this message:
access.message:
Assalamu'alaikum,

You have been invited as an admin of the Markaz Tadarus learning platform.

Open {{link}} and sign in with Google using {{email}}.
access.none: No admins yet. Only the super admin can open this platform.
access.removeBody: {{email}} will no longer be able to open the learning platform. Any site dashboards they have stay as they are.

classes.title: Schools
classes.intro: Create a school, choose the surahs it studies, then share its code. Teachers join at /guru with that code.
classes.empty: No schools yet. Create the first one to start assigning surahs.
classes.needLesson: Add a surah first under Surahs, then create a school.
classes.name: School name
classes.unpublishedHint: Surahs marked • are not published yet; teachers see them once published.
classes.deleteBody: The school {{name}} and its code will be deleted. Learners' progress is kept. The super admin can restore it from Recently deleted.
classes.codeHint: Teachers open {{link}} and enter this code.
classes.renew: New code (the old one stops working)
classes.shareText:
Assalamu'alaikum,

You are invited to the school *{{name}}* on the Markaz Tadarus learning platform.

1. Open {{link}}
2. Sign in with Google
3. Enter the code: *{{code}}*

Happy learning!
classes.noLearners: No learners yet. Share the school code or invite by email.
classes.surahsHint: Switch on the surahs open to this school. Its teachers see the surahs switched on (once they are published).
classes.inviteHint: Paste the teachers' Google emails (one per line). They join this school by themselves the first time they sign in at /guru, no code needed.
classes.removeLearnerBody: {{name}} will no longer see the surahs of {{klass}}. Their progress is kept.

sections.empty: This surah has no sections yet. Use the Teacher's Book layout, or make your own.
sections.useTemplate: Use the Teacher's Book layout ({{count}} sections)
sections.deleteBody: The section "{{name}}" and everything in it will be deleted. The super admin can restore it from Recently deleted for 30 days.
sections.name: Section name
sections.nameHint: Leave empty to use the standard name.
sections.kindWarning: This section already has questions or tasks. Changing its type may hide them from teachers.

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.intro: Every teacher who has joined, from all schools. Delete a teacher to remove their record and progress.
teachers.empty: No teachers yet. Teachers appear here once they join with a school code or an email invite.
teachers.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted with all their progress, scores, written answers and email invite.
teachers.deleteNote: The super admin can restore them from Recently deleted for 30 days. If they sign in again and use a school code, they join as a new learner.

board.tryAll: Try them all as a teacher
board.noSections: This surah has no question sections yet. Open the Learning list tab to add some.
board.addHere: Add a question to this section
board.pickIntro: Pick the section, then tap a card. The right form opens; you just fill it in.
board.saved: Saved ✓ This section now has {{count}} questions. Type the next one:
board.removeBody: It will be removed from {{section}} and cannot be brought back.

single.name: Multiple choice
single.desc: One correct answer among several options.

truefalse.name: True / False
truefalse.desc: A statement; the teacher picks true or false.
truefalse.ex: Al-Fatihah is recited every rak'ah → True

match.name: Matching
match.desc: Pair the left with the right; the right side is shuffled.

task.name: Written task
task.desc: The teacher answers in their own words; you read it and leave a note.
task.ex: Write one habit you want to improve

pageEditor.hint: This is the teacher's page. Type straight onto it: what you type appears exactly here for teachers.
pageEditor.heading: Heading

progressPage.title: Teacher progress
progressPage.sub: Who has started, how far each is, their scores, and who needs a nudge.
progressPage.none: No teachers in this school yet.
progressPage.attentionSub: Not started yet, or haven't opened the app for {{days}} days or more. Reach out to them.
progressPage.hardestSub: Lowest average scores. Check the questions, or go over these sections together.
progressPage.scoreNote: Score = each teacher's best score in each section with questions.

pdf.add: Add the material as a PDF
pdf.addHint: A PDF file, up to {{mb}} MB. Teachers read it right on this page and can download it.
pdf.tooLarge: The PDF is too large (up to {{mb}} MB).
pdf.failed: The PDF could not be added. Try again.
pdf.oldText: Text typed before (teachers see it until a PDF replaces it):
